notes.title: Hotfix V1.0.1
notes.content:
Version 1.0.1 of Subway Midnight is now live! This fixes the most critical reported bugs preventing the game from being run or progressed.

[b]Bug Fixes & Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added an FPS cap to stop lighting people's GPUs on fire
[*] Disabled Steam VR starting up for no reason
[*] Fixed invisible wall in the Shark Room
[*] Fixed the 4Gems wall being opened with only 3Gems
[*] Slowed down the smashers in the factory level, and fixed a weird load-in that made it unplayable
[*] Fixed doors in Rose's house staying locked after a bad ending
[/list]

Thank you all for playing, and for reporting your bugs on the discord! We'll keep a lookout for any other critical issues over the weekend! Happy Halloween!

notes.content: Wanna know what Subway Midnight is all about? Tune in for our broadcast of some gameplay to find out.

notes.title: SUBWAY MIDNIGHT - OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[b][h2]Happy Halloween! Subway Midnight is finally out![/h2][/b]
Everything happened so fast. Bubby Darkstar, the solo dev behind Subway Midnight, toiled for three years to bring this project to life, but only put out the first trailer for this game, like, a month ago looking for a publisher to take it the last mile. Somehow we (Aggro Crab Games) became that publisher (We're not a publisher lmao) and long story short we managed to get this spooky lil' adventure out by Halloween for you all to enjoy/fear.

[previewyoutube=yjMfIPbEkaE;full][/previewyoutube]

[b][h2]Spooky launch discount[/h2][/b]
Last week we made a deal with you. If the community got Subway Midnight on the Popular Upcoming List by wishlisting the game, then we promised to give you all a discount at launch. Well uh, you certainly pulled through! 
[b]10% OFF AS A LAUNCH DISCOUNT BABYYYY - GET IT WHILE ITS HOT[/b]

[b][h2]We're thirstin' for content[/h2][/b]
Seeing the community share their experiences when they play Subway Midnight is pretty sick. We'd love to put together some highlights from launch week. SO - if you wanna share any of the wild things that happen in Subway Midnight, you should join our Discord! Honestly, we thrive off that kinda stuff.

[url=https://discord.gg/AggroCrab]Join the Discord![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41261290/c9c70558b355d319d168dcac4ce00fe2a3258dfb.png[/img]

We really appreciate the overwhelming support towards Subway Midnight in this short time, we'll never forget it. Ok now go play Subway Midnight... ENJOY! (and don't forget to leave a review!)

[b]- Bubby Darkstar and Aggro Crab[/b]
